issue_context.title: Error setting up entry FRITZ!Box after update to 2021.6.x
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After updating to HA 2021.6.x I get the following error on startup:

> Error setting up entry FRITZ!Box 6490 Cable for fritz
Error setting up entry FRITZ!Box 7590 for fritz

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.6.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.5.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

fritz

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fritz/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/config_entries.py", line 285, in async_setup
    result = await component.async_setup_entry(hass, self)  # type: ignore
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/fritz/__init__.py", line 37, in async_setup_entry
    await fritz_tools.async_start(entry.options)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/fritz/common.py", line 104, in async_start
    await self.hass.async_add_executor_job(self.scan_devices)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 57, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/fritz/common.py", line 146, in scan_devices
    consider_home = self._options[CONF_CONSIDER_HOME]
KeyError: 'consider_home'
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hi @TheZoker , can you please check if going in 

Configurations->Integrations->AVM Fritz!Box Tools->Configure->Submit fix the issue ?

Thx,

Simone

Hi @chemelli74 
I already removed the integration and re-added it, so I can't test this, sorry. But I had the same error on three different instances with 5 fritzboxes
Thanks!

review_comments:
This should be reverted. We don't need to bump a schema version to fix this.

Additionally, this will break the possibility for users to downgrade HA.

Instead, this should have been handled as default on the place used.

> Additionally, this will break the possibility for users to downgrade HA.

oh yeah your are right ... honestly did not considered this 😕 
Many thanks for this hint 👍 
With this in mind, `async_migrate_entry()` seems always be very dangerous 🤔

Well dangerous... 😬 
It is helpful for migrating backward-incompatible changes. This case could be handled without being a breaking change.
